metaTitle: Eufy Permanent Light Installer | Ontario & GTA Homes
metaDescription: Professional Eufy Permanent Outdoor Lights installation across London Ontario and the GTA. Clean concealed mounting, safe wiring, app setup. Free quote.
heroIntro: Clean mounting, correct wiring and full app setup for Eufy's permanent outdoor lighting system on your home.
intro: Eufy's permanent outdoor lighting system, like other permanent LED products, is built to stay installed year round rather than come down every January. The install itself is where most homeowners run into trouble, mounting track evenly along a roofline, running power safely, and weatherproofing every connection so the system holds up through an Ontario winter. Our crew handles that side of the job so the system performs the way it is meant to from the first time you turn it on.

We mount the track so it sits flush and concealed against your fascia or trim, plan the wiring and power draw properly for the length of run involved, and pair the finished install to your Eufy app before we leave. Permanent installs like this typically fall between $3,000 and $8,000 depending on your home's size and roofline complexity, and once it is up, there is no seasonal takedown to schedule.
included: Assessment of your roofline for your Eufy Permanent Outdoor Lights kit
Concealed track mounting along fascia and trim
Wiring and power planning sized to the length of the run
Weatherproof connections built for Ontario winters
Clean daytime appearance with the lights off

sections.heading: How installation works
sections.text: Our crew first walks your roofline to confirm your Eufy kit's track length and power supply match the coverage you want, since permanent lighting is planned differently than a seasonal light package. We mount the track so it stays concealed along your fascia during the day, run wiring to a suitable power source, and weatherproof every connection point given how much Ontario winters put outdoor electrical work through. Once mounted, we pair the system to your Eufy app and confirm every section responds correctly before we leave.

sections.heading: What affects the cost
sections.text: Costs for permanent installs like this typically land between $3,000 and $8,000, driven mainly by the linear footage of track your roofline requires, how many sections or rooflines are involved, and the amount of additional wiring or power supply work needed. A single-storey home with one continuous roofline is a smaller job than a property with multiple rooflines, dormers or separate structures needing their own power runs. We give you a specific number once we have assessed your property in person.

sections.heading: What to expect after installation
sections.text: Once mounted and paired, your Eufy system runs entirely through the app, with no annual install or takedown required the way seasonal string lighting needs every year. You can switch colours and patterns for the holidays, then change it for everyday use or other occasions the rest of the year without calling us back for anything. If you want periodic checks on wiring and weatherproofing over time rather than waiting for something to fail on its own, ask about our optional ongoing service contract.

pricing: Eufy permanent outdoor lighting installs typically run between $3,000 and $8,000 depending on roofline length, number of sections, and how much wiring and power supply work the install requires. Since this is a one-time permanent install rather than a seasonal package, pricing reflects the mounting and electrical work involved. We confirm your exact cost after assessing your home.

faq.q: Do you supply the Eufy kit or just install it?
faq.a: This service is professional installation of your Eufy Permanent Outdoor Lights kit. We can advise on sizing your kit correctly before purchase so you get enough track for your roofline, but our focus is mounting, wiring and configuring the system properly once you have it in hand, rather than selling the hardware itself.

faq.q: How much does Eufy light installation cost?
faq.a: Most installs run between $3,000 and $8,000, depending on the length of track your roofline needs and how much wiring and power supply work is involved in reaching it cleanly. We assess your property first and confirm an exact quote before any work is scheduled or started, so there are no surprises once the crew arrives.

faq.q: Can the system handle Ontario winters?
faq.a: Yes, we weatherproof every connection point during installation specifically because Ontario winters put outdoor electrical work through significant temperature swings, ice and moisture over several months. Proper mounting and sealed connections are what keep a permanent system reliable through the cold rather than failing partway through the season, which is why the install itself matters as much as the hardware.

faq.q: Will I need to call you back to change scenes or colours?
faq.a: No. Once the system is installed and paired to your Eufy app, you control colours, patterns and schedules yourself whenever you like. We set up your first scenes during installation so you have a starting point, but changing them afterward for holidays or everyday use is entirely in your hands.
